parts.title: Muddy Kids
parts.text: Tess, Hugo, and Layla had a muddy day at the park. Mom filled the tub with warm water. A cloud of **steam** rose up. Layla poured in soap, and the water turned **frothy**. A big **bubble** floated to the ceiling.

parts.title: Scrub-a-Dub
parts.text: Hugo took a **sponge** and made a thick **lather** on his arms. Tess began to **scrub** the mud off her knees. The water started to **slosh** over the side.

parts.title: All Clean
parts.text: Layla used a cup to **rinse** the soap from her hair. Her fingers began to **wrinkle**. Mom pulled the plug to **drain** the tub. Hugo’s knees were **spotless**! Layla squeezed her rubber duck, and it gave a **squeaky** quack.

parts.title: Cozy and Warm
parts.text: The children dried off with fluffy towels. They put on warm pajamas. Mom read them a story, and soon they were fast asleep.

definitions.meaning1: A thin ball of soap or water filled with air. Example: I blew a bubble and it floated away.

definitions.meaning1: The warm mist that rises from hot water. Example: Steam rose from the hot cocoa.

definitions.meaning1: A small fold or line in skin or cloth. Example: There is a wrinkle in my shirt.

definitions.meaning1: To let water flow out. Example: We drain the sink when we are done.
definitions.meaning2: A hole where water flows out. Example: The water goes down the drain.

definitions.meaning1: Perfectly clean, with no spots. Example: The kitchen was spotless after we cleaned.

definitions.meaning1: A soft thing that soaks up water. Example: I wipe the table with a sponge.
definitions.meaning2: To wipe with a sponge. Example: Please sponge the spill off the counter.
